correctness.rationale: The derivation parametrization D_{A,f} on V plus exterior square V is exhaustive, and D²=D is exactly A²=A, L_A²=L_A, fA+L_Af=f. The eigenvalues (2,1,0) of L_A on Λ²U, U∧W, Λ²W imply r≤1 outside characteristic two, while all r occur in characteristic two. The restrictions on f are necessary and sufficient; conjugation by a central shear h with h|U=f|U and h|W=-f|W removes f. Gaussian counts of complementary kernels and linear dimensions of allowed f give both displayed rank polynomials. Direct checker enumeration agrees at (n,q)=(2,2),(3,2),(2,3),(2,5); all nonstandard deductions are justified in RESULT.md. Finite tests are corroboration, not an infinite proof.

value.rationale: Composition-idempotent derivations produce natural two-eigenspace gradings in characteristic two; beyond characteristic two they force the generator projection to rank at most one. The complete orbit and labeled-rank census for every n≥3 and all finite fields is a motivated structural invariant that detects the characteristic jump, ranks exceeding generator rank, and rank collisions among distinct conjugacy classes. It is neither a one-off parameter slice nor a recomputation of a previously tabulated invariant. Its standalone exactness is useful for comparing modular Lie grading phenomena and automorphism actions even without a further downstream theorem.
